name: Slider
summary: Choose a number in a range by dragging. Useful when exploring matters more than the exact value.
use: Explore amounts or percentages, like a monthly amount in a calculator.
avoid: Exact input: use Input with type="number", or combine both.
anatomy: Handle (one for Single, two for Range).
figmaProps: Pressed: the handle grows from 24 to 32 px.
reactProps: For example "€650". Also becomes the aria-valuetext.
behaviour: Pressed: while the user holds the handle (mouse or touch), it grows from 24 to 32 px. Letting go makes it small again.
Arrow keys move one step. Home and End jump to min and max.
a11y: aria-valuetext gives the formatted value, not only the number.
content: Show the unit in the value ("€650 per month").
dont: A slider without a label or without a visible value.
open: Range (two handles) exists in Figma. In React use Range slider.
